messages:
maria: FYI PM escalated — token cost dashboard shows $0 or NaN for 3 orgs in the last 24h. Ticket INF-1229. @ryan can you look? :frowning:
ryan: On it. Which orgs?
maria: orgs: org_842, org_1307, org_4401. I saw it in /console/costs?range=24h
lee: saw one with cost=NaN in our internal query too. Possibly cost calculation returned null. :eyes:
ops-bot: deploy success release/2026-03-16 22:14 UTC (sha: a1b2c3)
ryan: any repro steps? can you paste query you used?
maria: steps:
```
1) Go to Console -> Analytics -> Token costs
2) Select Last 24 hours
3) Org filter: org_842
Expected: cost per token and total cost. Actual: $0 or NaN
``` 
maria: Also ran this on prod db:
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM token_events
WHERE org_id IN ('org_842','org_1307','org_4401')
  AND ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY org_id;
```
maria: result: org_842 -> tokens=0 cost=NULL ; org_1307 -> tokens=1234 cost=0 ; org_4401 -> tokens=NULL cost=NULL
ryan: Hmm. cost aggregation shows NULL when tokens=0 or tokens NULL. I suspect upstream event ingestion or a recent change in cost calc service. I'll check cost_aggregator logs.
ryan: (logs)
```
2026-03-16T22:15:01Z ERROR cost_aggregator - Division by zero when computing unit_cost for org org_842
2026-03-16T22:15:02Z WARN  cost_aggregator - token_count missing for event id=ff12
```
lee: That's consistent. New events missing token_count cause cost to be NULL and dashboard prints $0 or NaN. Was there a schema change in ingestion? @sam from eng-ingest?
sam: I pushed a change to the ingest pipeline last week to tolerate missing token_count, but I didn't add a fallback in cost calc — my bad. I'll revert/fix.
ryan: Quick mitigation: dashboard should defensively render 'N/A' when cost IS NULL and not show $0. I'll patch frontend to treat null/NaN specially. Also will add backfill job to compute cost for affected orgs.
maria: Can we ETA on fix so I can respond to PM and the customers?
sam: I'll ship hotfix to cost_aggregator in 30m, and run backfill in ~1h. I'll post PR.
ryan: I'll open frontend PR to show N/A and not map NaN to $0. PR -> r/1234
lee: Customer comms: draft message to affected customers and link to incident notes. I'll add to ticket INF-1229.
maria: thanks. tagging this as high-priority. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-03-16-22 (priority: high) by maria
ryan: follow-ups: (1) fix cost_aggregator fallback (2) backfill missing costs (3) frontend render fix (4) add unit test for null handling
sam: doing 1+2 now. will ping when done.
maria: I'll update ticket and notify PMs once backfill completes.
ryan: resolve when all 4 done. I'll monitor dashboard metrics.
maria: ack
